scheme_name: Leave Travel Concession Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: The applicant must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
The worker must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
The monthly salary of the worker must not exceed ₹18,000
The worker must have a service period of 5 years
The worker must not have received any LTC amount earlier in the concerned 4‑year block
benefits_summary: A one-time leave travel concession of ₹1,500 is provided to the worker once every 4‑year block.
